description: This file implements the StkService class, which handles SIM Toolkit (STK) commands and interactions within a modem simulator environment. It includes methods for processing USAT envelope commands, terminal responses, and managing the current selection menu state, as well as generating unsolicited responses based on SIM profile data.

classes.name: StkService
classes.description: A class that manages SIM Toolkit commands and interactions in a modem simulation environment.

methods.name: InitializeCommandHandlers
methods.description: Initializes and returns a list of command handlers for STK commands.

methods.name: HandleReportStkServiceIsRunning
methods.description: Handles the AT+CUSATD command to report if the STK service is running and its profile status.

methods.name: HandleSendEnvelope
methods.description: Processes the AT+CUSATE command to send a USAT envelope command to the SIM.

methods.name: HandleSendTerminalResponseToSim
methods.description: Processes the AT+CUSATT command to send a terminal response to the SIM.

methods.name: GetCurrentSelectItem
methods.description: Retrieves the current selected menu item element from the ICC profile.

methods.name: OnUnsolicitedCommandForTR
methods.description: Handles unsolicited commands related to terminal responses, updating menu state and sending appropriate unsolicited responses.
